summary: Elaborated every planned story for iteration `feedback-request-batch-upload` with requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, assumptions, cross-story rules, and evidence. Preserved planned story ids: `feedback-batch-data-model`, `feedback-excel-upload-ui`, `feedback-file-parser-validation`, `feedback-batch-creation`, `feedback-link-generation`, `feedback-request-email-sender`, `feedback-email-status-tracking`, and `feedback-upload-non-browser-verification`. Evidence reviewed included the current protected Feedback Request placeholder, Prisma schema without feedback models, package dependencies without an Excel parser, the existing authenticated dashboard shell, and the server-only Gmail welcome-email pattern. No tests, browser checks, Playwright, app server, deployment, publishing, or real email sending were run for this business-analysis task.
